ScoredSeeds and ObjectnessViewStage both predict and supervise the 'objectness' of a seed; a detector needs exactly one owner for it. ScoredSeeds selects its seeds by objectness (`select_by: objectness`), which reads the objectness it predicts, so it cannot leave objectness to the view stage. Keep ScoredSeeds with a view stage that does not predict it (DirectionViewStage, HealpixViewStage, IcosphereViewStage, LatticeViewStage, RomaRotationViewStage, TemplateViewStage, TwoVectorViewStage), or keep ObjectnessViewStage with a proposal that does not (SampledSeeds, SubsampledSeeds).
